output.reason: [ev-387dcb005901] names `istio-cni-node` as a DaemonSet whose memory footprint was improved. It does not name a container image or repository. The proposed image-in-use{name: istio-cni-node} treats the DaemonSet name as an image repository, which the evidence does not support and which may not match anything. correction.statement: Environments that run the istio-cni-node DaemonSet get the reduced memory footprint (up to 80% less in many cases). Exposure is the presence of that DaemonSet, not the use of an image with that name.
